findings.claim: When no surrogate is specified, the collector always builds a contractless string-key model and never examines attributes on the formatted type. Consequently, MessagePack attributes such as [Key] and [IgnoreMember] on T are ignored—for example, an [IgnoreMember] property is serialized and an integer [Key(7)] is replaced by the property-name string key—contrary to the acceptance criterion that attributes on T are honoured.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the generated test MessagePackAttributesOnReferencedTypeAreHonored. It compiles a referenced type with [MessagePackObject], [Key(7)] on Id, and [IgnoreMember] on Secret, then requires the generated formatter to write key 7 and not access Secret. The current contractless implementation fails both assertions.

findings.claim: MsgPack020 and its documentation require exactly one IMessagePackFormatter<T> interface, but the collector rejects only zero interfaces. A formatter implementing two such interfaces silently uses formatterInterfaces[0], producing a formatter for an arbitrarily selected data type instead of the documented error.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a generator test with an annotated partial class implementing both IMessagePackFormatter<FirstType> and IMessagePackFormatter<SecondType>. Assert MsgPack020 and no generated formatter body. The current Length == 0 check produces neither the required diagnostic nor a deterministic rejection.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Expose GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute with the optional SurrogateType property implemented here: contractless generation is the default, while a compile-time surrogate supplies Key/IgnoreMember metadata and MsgPack022 validates its member mappings.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Implement only the settled acceptance surface for now: GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute without SurrogateType, contractless generation for unattributed types, and honouring attributes already present on T. Remove surrogate collection and MsgPack022 until the thread's unresolved key-customization design is chosen.
